notes: Assignment round-trips asymmetrically: GET echoes flat userIds/userGroupIds, but POST/PUT want a {contains:"CONTAINS", ids, status} filter under users/userGroups. A holiday with no resolvable assignment is rejected.
DELETE returns 200 with the HolidayDetailsDto body, not 204.

Bare array; page/page-size accepted; holidays is in the audited Last-Page-header stamped set (FACT gen-clockify-openapi.pagination-params-stamped), though the record's Pagination line itself does not restate the header.
assigned-to, start, and end query params are all required by live Clockify.
assigned-to must be a user ID; user-group IDs are not supported and may produce a misleading 403.
PUT replaces the document; omitted fields 400 'must not be null'.
No single-GET route exists; callers must list-scan to rebuild the full body before update.
Assignment must be reconstructed into the {contains:"CONTAINS", ids, status} filter under users/userGroups; preserving assignment scope is mandatory.
